text: Barrels of salt fish stand stacked by the water, and the gulls have opinions about every one.
why: Stacked barrels of salt fish by the water in a famine whose failed food source is fish; stores are about one month.

fold: Nets hang drying on poles, and the smell of the catch follows you.
text: Nets hang drying on poles, and the smell of the catch follows you.
why: offers the smell of the catch and drying nets under a famine whose failed source is fish; the line offers the food that failed

fold: Horse traders show their animals at the edge of the settlement, where herders and townsfolk meet.
text: Horse traders show their animals at the edge of the settlement, where herders and townsfolk meet.
why: herders and townsfolk meet to trade horses; safety is Quarantined (plague), and HOUSES has no pack-animal trader or market

fold: Bolts of cloth and bales of wool fill the carts waiting on the road out.
text: Bolts of cloth and bales of wool fill the carts waiting on the road out.
why: carts of cloth and wool going out; TRADE exports and made-here list no cloth or wool (only fish, herbs, honey, iron, spices, transit)

fold: Stalls sell reagents in stoppered jars, and the buyers know exactly what they want.
text: Stalls sell reagents in stoppered jars, and the buyers know exactly what they want.
why: stalls selling reagents: HOUSES has no alchemist or apothecary, and TRADE and INCOME name no reagent trade
